_comment: Measured Microsoft Excel geometry for Zaldros Sheets. Same rule as win11-reference.json:
no number here is a guess, and every number names the capture it came from.
Sources (Microsoft's own support CDN, fetched 2026-08-28, stored under docs/sheets/refs/):
light  theme-colorful-excel-light.png  873x617  Microsoft 365 Excel, Colorful theme
dark   theme-black-dark.png            874x643  Microsoft 365 Excel, Black theme
Both show the 2023 visual refresh (Aptos Narrow, rounded ribbon card) — the current Excel,
not the 2019 ribbon in the owner's second screenshot.
Scale: the captures are not at 100%. The anchor is the grid row, which measures 38 device
pixels in the light capture and is 20 px in Excel at 100% — so device px / 1.90 = our px.
Every derived value below is rounded to a whole pixel and marked with the raw measurement.
Column pitch measures 136 device px (71.6 at our scale); Excel's documented default column
width at 100% is 64 px, so column width is taken from Excel's own default, not from this
capture, and the discrepancy is recorded rather than hidden.

grid._column_width_note: Excel's documented 100% default (8.43 chars); the capture measures 71.6
grid._row_header_width_note: 56/1.9 = 29.5; Excel widens it with the row count

dark.title: #1c2227
dark._accent_note: the light accent lightened, not a different hue
